mitosis.write_policy: Derived facts must carry source_universal_ids when available; absent provenance remains explicit.
mitosis.sharing_policy: public sharing OFF unless explicitly authorized

allowed: restorable execution snapshots after secret scrub
prohibited: Tenki Code Reviewer for private Vithia code
publication of benchmarks whose subject is Tenki service without written consent
tenki.measurement_policy: Experiment score/steps/model metrics may be recorded; Tenki infrastructure performance must remain operational metadata unless written consent permits benchmarking disclosure.
tenki.snapshot_policy: Snapshots capture VM disk+memory but not attached volumes; scrub credentials before snapshot and keep durable datasets in explicitly bound volumes where used.

sponsor_claim_rule: SPONSOR_USED=true only after a load-bearing integration executes and produces a receipt. Source documentation alone is not sponsor usage.
